examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Single-line value entry with label, prefix and helper copy.
examples.behavior: Accepts a short project-scoped value and keeps the action inside the control.
examples.qa: Label, value, helper and clear action stay aligned at dense widths.

examples.title: Keyboard focus
examples.description: Visible focus ring for keyboard navigation.
examples.behavior: Focus is shown on the full control shell, not only the text cursor.
examples.qa: Ring has enough contrast and does not resize the field.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: Unavailable input when policy or async lock prevents edits.
examples.behavior: Value remains readable while edit and clear actions are inactive.
examples.qa: Disabled state is perceivable without hiding the current value.

examples.title: Validation error
examples.description: Inline error copy tied to the failing input.
examples.behavior: Error replaces helper copy and marks only the invalid control.
examples.qa: Error message is explicit and does not push neighboring rows unpredictably.

default.trigger: Editable field with a valid current value
default.qa: Label, helper and action are visible.

focus-visible.qa: Focus ring surrounds the input shell.

disabled.trigger: Permission, prerequisite or pending mutation blocks edits

loading.trigger: Value is being checked or saved
loading.qa: Loading copy stays in helper area.

error.qa: Error copy is specific and adjacent to the control.

mobile.qa: Prefix, value and action still fit.
